blocker: Native required-runner evidence is absent: macOS amd64, Linux amd64/arm64, and Windows amd64 observations must be independently produced; cross-builds are not native execution evidence.
command: sh -c d=$(mktemp -d); GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -o "$d/omg-darwin-amd64" ./cmd/omg && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o "$d/omg-linux-amd64" ./cmd/omg && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -o "$d/omg-linux-arm64" ./cmd/omg && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o "$d/omg-windows-amd64.exe" ./cmd/omg && test -s "$d/omg-darwin-amd64" && test -s "$d/omg-linux-amd64" && test -s "$d/omg-linux-arm64" && test -s "$d/omg-windows-amd64.exe"; r=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $r
